findings.summary: Some new ranges miss my round-3 outputs though the note says each covers both reviewers: e.g. benchmark causal 0 rejected at D = 128 (mine 28-36%, README 34-38%), tolV at D = 64, N = 4096 (6.6, 7.3)
findings.detail:
The table note says each range covers three heads and both reviewers' round-3 evaluations (all rows, or 96 or 128 evenly spread rows). My round-3 work/tolerance.out (kernels/attn_fwd_e5m2/review/round-3/r-e5fwd2/work/tolerance.out: all rows at N = 128, 96 rows otherwise, seeds 1 and 2) falls outside these ranges.

Main table:
- test-like D = 64, causal tolO at N = 128: mine 0.089 to 0.091 (README 0.092 to 0.093).
- test-like D = 64, tolV at N = 4096: mine 6.6 (README 7.3; the D = 128 row says 6.6 to 7.3).
- test-like D = 128, tolM: mine 0.093 at N = 128 (README 0.097 to 0.099), 0.116 to 0.120 at 1024 (README 0.117), 0.126 at 4096 (README 0.129 to 0.130).
- benchmark D = 64, causal: tolO 0.43 to 0.46 (README 0.42 to 0.43); 0 rejected on 64% to 67% (README 66% to 69%).
- benchmark D = 128, causal: tolO 0.86 to 1.01 (README 0.85 to 0.90); 0 rejected on 28% to 36% (README 34% to 38%).
- test-like non-causal median |attnRef| at N = 128: 0.044 to 0.066 (README 0.047 to 0.068).

Per-N_CTX table:
- N = 128 non-causal fp8 floor share: 37% to 54% (README 36% to 52%).
- N = 128 causal median |attnRef|: 0.065 to 0.094 (README 0.070 to 0.096).
- N = 4096 causal floor share: 83% to 93% (README 84% to 93%).

Read this first: tolO is 5.1 to 18.4 times the floor on the benchmark's data (README 'about 5 to 16').

All of these are within sampling noise, and no conclusion changes. Either widen the ranges or drop the sentence that they cover both reviewers' evaluations.

release.note: Answered. The causal shares at N_CTX >= 1024 are now 4.5-6.6% and 1-2.2% rejected (mine over 96 rows: 5.4-5.8% and 1.7-2.2%). A sentence now says that row 0 has one key, is always rejected, and is 1/N_CTX of the rows. Every smaller mismatch F10 listed is covered now: N_CTX = 128 meets Post on 81-88% and 61-67% (mine 82.4-88.2% and 61.9-67.1%); the causal floor share is 25-38% (mine 26.2-38.0%); the benchmark rejects 0 on 45-57% and 9.5-19% (mine 46-47% and 12-17%); pE's largest values are 1.46-1.65 and 3.05-3.87 (mine 1.46-1.56 and 3.18-3.42); tolM at D = 64, N = 128 is 0.030-0.032 (mine 0.030); the vEff = 0 tolO at the cap at 2^14 is 1.0-1.4e-4 (mine 1.0-1.1e-4). The ranges that the README widened since then are a new DOC.

notes: Round 4 changed only README.md; the gate (4740b3814ba92693) and the item digests are unchanged, so every item stays accepted. I took no new samples: the figures that miss my outputs are within sampling noise. On r-e5fwd's F9: the same recomputation over all rows of three heads, and the row-0 sentence, answer its causal-share point, as far as I can judge. Whether r-e5fwd releases it is theirs.
